name: linux_time_stomp
author: jm33-ng
comment: Set a file's atime/mtime (now, zero, or an explicit epoch) via utimensat(2)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: now (current time), zero (unix epoch), or set (use --epoch)

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: Unix seconds to stamp when mode=set

name: oom_cage
author: jm33-ng
comment: Inspect or set a process's OOM killer score (protect self, expose a target) via /proc/<pid>/oom_score_adj

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Target PID (empty or 'self' for the agent itself)

name: cgroup_freeze
author: jm33-ng
comment: Report, freeze or thaw the cgroup v2 of a process; refuses the agent's own cgroup

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Target PID (empty or 'self' for the agent itself)

name: pidfd_steal
author: jm33-ng
comment: Duplicate another process's open file descriptor with pidfd_getfd and read it, without opening the path ourselves

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: PID that holds the target fd

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor number in the target process (see proc_fd_scan)

parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: Maximum bytes to read from the stolen fd
